description: Get the confirmed rate of the quote the customer chose. Call it first with bundleId only: that selects the quote and returns the status, which may list what the confirmed rate still needs, then a confirmation. After the customer says yes to that confirmation, call again with its token and the customer's exact reply. Nothing is requested unless requested comes back true. Once it is, the insurer confirms the rate, which usually takes about 3 to 10 minutes; jerry_wait waits for it. A quote with continuesInApp gets its confirmed rate in the Jerry app instead: the first call requests nothing and returns continue_in_app with the quote's url.

bundleId.description: The bundleId of the chosen quote.

confirmation.description: Omit on the first call, which selects the quote and returns the confirmation to show.

token.description: The status confirmation's token; a changed fact makes it stale.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for safely retrying this customer action

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool.

name: jerry_request_final_price
title: Request confirmed rate
